note: RFC 9012 Section 13, rfc/full/rfc9012.txt:1695-1705: "Sub-TLVs of this sort MUST be disregarded." The deciding clarification is also a whole sentence: "That is, they MUST NOT affect the creation of the encapsulation header." The antecedent is a sub-TLV meaningless for the containing tunnel type, such as a UDP port for a non-UDP tunnel or a mismatched Protocol Type. No tagged carriers exist for this row. Independently read checkRouteBestChange and the supporting SubTLVs/tunnelTLVLayout boundaries: opaque signaling and endpoint/framing validation exist, but election exports no attribute-23 encapsulation parameters and no type-specific encapsulation consumer is present in the scoped FIB/sysrib/RIB search. Thus unchanged propagation/non-malformed treatment cannot establish this header-construction disregard rule. Retain unimplemented, the checkRouteBestChange guard and the declared plan/post-release/features/spec-bgp-tunnel-encapsulation-consumption.md boundary. Existing 13-18/-19 and RFC9830 assertions/claims remain untouched and are not credited to 13-16. No checks run.
